summary: BUG-017 fix verified. Duplicate ingredient filter is working correctly in both Recipe Catalogue and Sub-Recipe Master BOM editors. When an ingredient is selected in one row, it is excluded from other row dropdowns. Removing a row makes the ingredient available again.

features_tested.details: First dropdown: 49 options. After selecting Ajwain, second dropdown: 48 options (Ajwain excluded). Third dropdown: 47 options (Ajwain and Almonds excluded).
After removing Ajwain row, dropdown shows 49 options again with Ajwain available.
First dropdown: 49 options. After selecting Ajwain, second dropdown: 48 options (Ajwain excluded, starts with Almonds).

features_tested.feature: Ingredient dropdowns load correctly with filtering
features_tested.details: Both Recipe and Sub-Recipe dropdowns load all inventory items and filter correctly based on selections.

RecipeCatalogue.jsx.implementation: inventoryMaster.filter(m => !ingredients.some((other, j) => j !== ing.idx && String(other.ingredient_id) === String(m.id)))
RecipeCatalogue.jsx.notes: Filter excludes IDs selected in OTHER rows using j !== ing.idx comparison

SubRecipeMaster.jsx.implementation: inventoryMaster.filter(m => !ingredients.some((other, j) => j !== idx && String(other.ingredient_id) === String(m.id)))
SubRecipeMaster.jsx.notes: Same filter logic, excludes IDs selected in OTHER rows using j !== idx comparison
